bio_en: Hrach Avetisian was born in Alexandropol in 1880 into a prosperous family that moved to Kaghzvan, and in 1895 entered the Nersisian school in Tiflis, where meeting Kristapor drew him into the ARF for life. Sent by Kristapor to the Kars border on arms transport, he was arrested and jailed by the Russians; he served in the army from 1900 to 1903. In the 1905 Armenian-Tatar clashes he fought in the Zangezur self-defence with Murad of Sebastia, Avo and Korium, and he later took part in the February 1921 uprising. He lived his last years in Iran and died of pneumonia in Tehran in May 1932, having joked that 'it is not my turn yet'.
